decisions.summary: claims axis in switches.py, CLAIMS_STATES (report, clean), default report; malformed claims entry closes to clean; write keeps the axis it is not setting; make claims-report-only / claims-clean REASON= through _switch, which commits; ships at report with the GM's words
decisions.why: FR-001 and FR-004 as written (GM: 'building the check that we want, but then disabling it'). The write fix is required for FR-001's one tracked file holding both axes; it adds no behavior the request did not ask for.

decisions.summary: scripts/record/claims_carry.py reads the switch through its own stdlib reader claims_mode(root), default report, malformed -> clean
decisions.why: Implementation choice; same default and same fail-closed direction as D1 and FR-001, so it narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: At report the gate refuses only owed claims and delta_form_problems; introduced, carried and known findings become warnings; record_known writes nothing; file_carries returns at once; land.py's claims route and wait unchanged
decisions.why: FR-002 verbatim; carries the GM's 'ignore claims so long as they are properly marked and show up in the claims report'.

decisions.summary: make claims-carry REFUSES at report with a message naming the switch, where FR-002 says it 'says the switch is at report'
decisions.why: A carry filed at report becomes a task holding a feature open - the 2026-10-17 option 3 the GM set aside - so refusing serves the request. It is a refusal added, so FR-006 (test proven to fire with it deleted) binds it; the Constitution Check's guard-doctrine line names only D3's refusal and is incomplete on that point, not a decision to skip the test.

decisions.summary: At clean the gate refuses as today (owed, introduced, unfiled carried, unrecorded known) plus every open finding the report lists (DRIFTED, NEEDS-RESEARCH, MISLABELED, UNCLAIMED, UNDECIDED, CANNOT-TELL), less DEFERRED, each naming make claims-bundle UNITS=
decisions.why: FR-003 plus FR-002's 'At clean both behave as today' (file_carries and record_known read the gate's refusals, so the gate must still present carried and known at clean). A superset of FR-003's base, not a narrowing; carries the GM's long-run 'no open claims' on landing. Seam for the implementer: FR-003 excepts DEFERRED findings; if today's unfiled-carried refusal fires on a DEFERRED carried finding, the clean gate would refuse what FR-003 excepts - SC-003's passing fixture should include one.

decisions.summary: The report's selection lifted into open_findings(root), read by both the gate and make claims-report
decisions.why: Enforcement of FR-003 (the gate refuses exactly what the report lists).

decisions.summary: 405's status line opens 'Withdrawn 2026-10-28' with the ruling and evidence; phase-inputs.md lists T98, T101 under web, T104, T106 under homesteads, T111 under track, T165's notes under homesteads and lane_wells, each with its task text; 444's FR-001 derivation reads them as part of each stage's contract
decisions.why: FR-005 and the accepted recommendation ('move to 444 as inputs to their phases'); reading them as the stage's contract is what an input to a phase is.

decisions.summary: docs/guards.md claims-gate row, claims-gate.sh's message and root CLAUDE.md's claims line name the switch and its state
decisions.why: FR-006 as written.

decisions.summary: No performance bookends (no code a roll runs changes); no complexity tracking; tooling only, no engine code
decisions.why: Nothing the request or spec asks for is dropped.

decisions.summary: claims axis in switches.py, default report, malformed entry closed to clean, absent read as report, write keeps the other axis, two targets through _switch, dev/switches.json thrown to report with the GM's words; test throws both axes both ways
decisions.why: D1/FR-001/FR-004 verbatim; the GM asked to build the check and disable it ('building the check that we want, but then disabling it'), which is report as shipped default with clean available.

decisions.summary: red exit: recorded and set down, a claim that it cannot be done goes to make arbiter-ask
decisions.why: Process for a failed task, not scope; changes nothing the GM asked for.

decisions.summary: claims_mode, gate at report lands introduced/carried/known findings with no task filed and no gm-review.jsonl row, refuses an owed claim, refuses make claims-carry at report with the refusal's own test proven to fire with it deleted
decisions.why: D2/FR-002/SC-002: the GM's 'ignore claims so long as they are properly marked and show up in the claims report'. The deletion-proof test is enforcement of the requested refusal (SC-005), not added scope.

decisions.summary: at clean, refuses a fixture whose report lists an open finding and passes one whose only findings are DEFERRED, a DEFERRED carried finding among them
decisions.why: D3/FR-003/SC-003 exclude DEFERRED (load_deferred) from open findings, and the GM's long-run rule ('no open claims' at each landing) does not reach a recorded deferral. Condition: D3 also says clean refuses 'as today' an unfiled carried finding; this exit holds only if today's carried check already honors DEFERRED. If it does not, the exit goes red and what is owed is a spec amendment to D3 (re-reviewed), not a quiet loosening of the 'as today' leg.

decisions.summary: open_findings lifted from the report and read by both gate and make claims-report
decisions.why: D3 verbatim; makes the clean refusal list exactly what the report lists, which is the GM's 'show up in the claims report'.

decisions.summary: 405 status Withdrawn with evidence; phase-inputs.md holds the six tasks' texts under their stages; exit: speckit-todo lists 405 closed, each task named once
decisions.why: D4/FR-005/SC-004 and the recommendation the GM accepted (close 405; T98, T101, T104, T106, T111, T165 move to 444 as phase inputs).

decisions.summary: any measured figure in the moved task texts marked as today's count so 444's budget bundles leave it out (443 FR-008's refusal holds)
decisions.why: The task texts still move whole, as D4 and the accepted recommendation require; the marking only keeps them compatible with an already-landed rule (443 FR-008: the budget bundle refuses counts). It removes nothing the GM asked to move and carves no case out of 445's request.

decisions.summary: guards.md, claims-gate.sh message and root CLAUDE.md name the switch and its state; make feature-report F=445 WRITE=1
decisions.why: D5/FR-006/SC-005; the feature report is the routine record, not new behavior.

decisions.summary: switches.py gains a claims axis, CLAIMS_STATES report/clean, default report; an absent claims entry reads as report
decisions.why: D1 verbatim; serves the GM's 'building the check that we want, but then disabling it' (FR-001, FR-004)

decisions.summary: a malformed claims entry closes to clean, the strict state
decisions.why: settled by the accepted spec's D1; fails toward the check the GM wants in the long run, and does not change the shipped state, which is report

decisions.summary: write keeps the axis it is not setting, so a claims throw keeps remote
decisions.why: D1 verbatim; without it the switch would silently drop the remote axis, so it is needed for the switch to work at all

decisions.summary: make claims-report-only and make claims-clean throw the axis through _switch, which commits
decisions.why: D1 and FR-001: the only writers of the switch; the 'disabling' the GM asked for, reversible to the check he wants long-term

decisions.summary: dev/switches.json ships at claims: report with the GM's words as its reason
decisions.why: FR-004 and D1; the GM: 'for now, I just want to basically ignore claims so long as they are properly marked'

decisions.summary: test_switches.py throws both axes both ways, reads malformed claims as clean and absent as report, and finds remote kept after a claims throw
decisions.why: SC-001; a test that only fails when D1's behavior is absent - enforcement of the request, not added scope

decisions.summary: on failure: recorded and set down, a claim it cannot be done goes to make arbiter-ask
decisions.why: procedure for a failed task; narrows nothing asked and drops no requirement - an impossibility claim goes to the arbiter rather than being decided by the session

decisions.summary: T01's checklist: goal 'a claims switch on record, thrown with a reason, shipped at report'; constraints FR-001, FR-004, D1; green exit tests/test_switches.py on both axes; done = dev/switches.json reads claims: report with the GM's words.
decisions.why: Restates FR-001/FR-004/D1 and SC-001 without dropping any part: the two targets with a reason, the report default, the GM's words as reason ('building the check that we want, but then disabling it'). 'Both axes' matches D1's write keeping remote and claims.

decisions.summary: T02's checklist: goal 'findings recorded, not refused, at report; every open finding refused at clean'; constraints FR-002, FR-003, D2, D3; green exit tests/tooling/test_claims_switch.py with each refusal red when deleted; done = a landing at report passes with findings warned and none filed.
decisions.why: Matches the GM's 'ignore claims so long as they are properly marked and show up in the claims report' (report state: warned, not filed, owed claims and form problems still refused per FR-002) and his long-run rule (clean state refuses every open finding, FR-003). The done measure names the report case; the clean case is carried by the cited D3 and the green exit's tests (SC-003). The deletion test is FR-006's enforcement, not extra scope. Nothing excepted beyond what FR-002/FR-003 already carry.

decisions.summary: T03's checklist: goal '405 closed and its engine work handed to the phases that rebuild it'; constraints FR-005, D4; world check reads 405's open tasks against STAGES (observed 2026-10-28, with method); green exit make speckit-todo lists 405 closed; done = phase-inputs.md names each of the six tasks once.
decisions.why: The accepted recommendation verbatim: close 405, move T98, T101, T104, T106, T111 and T165 to 444 as inputs to their phases. The 'six tasks' census matches the request's list exactly; the STAGES read is how D4's per-stage placement is checked, a measurement with its date and method. No task is left out or added.

decisions.summary: T04's checklist: goal 'the switch and its state named where a session reads about the claims gate'; constraints FR-006, D5; green exit the docs name the switch; done = the feature report written; ordered last.
decisions.why: Restates FR-006/D5 (guards.md, the gate's message, CLAUDE.md naming the switch and its state). The green exit's shorter wording ('name the switch') does not narrow the cited constraint, which item 1 and FR-006 both carry with its state. Ordering and the feature-report done line are process, not scope.
